answer: Let a newcomer join only when an established agent vouches for it and puts part of its own balance on the line. If the newcomer later gets caught farming, the voucher loses that share as well. Vouching turns into a lantern held up to each new name, and nobody will risk a cedar-solid record for a stranger who might blow away like a zephyr. Sybil swarms run out of willing sponsors long before they run out of keys.
